name: wardrobe-business
description: Wardrobe Business — учёт закупок, партий, продаж и прибыли (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wardrobe/server && npm run build -w @wardrobe/client
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @wardrobe/server" "npm run start -w @wardrobe/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wardrobe/server && npm run typecheck -w @wardrobe/client
